definitions.theta: atan2(hypot(vx,vy),vz), relative to native +z; not a reconciled detector arm
definitions.theta_folded: atan2(hypot(vx,vy),abs(vz)), relative to the nearer native +z or -z axis
definitions.population: final stored tracked secondary particles; one record is one particle, not one pair
definitions.time: final tracking output only; no per-frame tracking history is exported
definitions.joint: logarithmic axes; nonpositive theta/pT retained in explicit exclusion counts
definitions.signed_energy: native charge encoding retained as sign counts; no detector-arm or species inference
definitions.limitations: native serialization precision; no row-level physical weights or separable recoil-origin tag
